scope: Derived metadata only from existing 36 attempt exports; no request replay or new generation.

metric_notes.input_growth_tokens: Difference in total provider-reported input between adjacent model requests. Includes new assistant/native reasoning and tool material; not attribution exclusively to the preceding tool.
metric_notes.item_json_bytes_by_type: Serialized JSON item bytes, ensure_ascii=True, excluding enclosing list separators and other request fields; size decomposition, not token counts. Opaque reasoning bytes are counted, never decoded/copied.
metric_notes.cache_write_tokens: Native input_cache_write_tokens is an input subset; provider total input is input+cached+cache-write. Cached tokens still form part of context.
